cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate R&D Engineering Lab Technician — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear nVent Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate R&D Engineering Lab Technician opportunity with nVent at nVent.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Representative — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear VCA Animal Hospitals Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Representative opportunity with VCA Animal Hospitals at VCA Animal Hospitals.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Research Coordinator - Department of Ophthalmology — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear The Mount Sinai Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Research Coordinator - Department of Ophthalmology opportunity with The Mount Sinai Hospital at The Mount Sinai Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Pre-ETS Instructor - Rossville IN — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Public Consulting Group Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Pre-ETS Instructor - Rossville IN opportunity with Public Consulting Group at Public Consulting Group.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

Dear Mass General Brigham Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Lab Tech I - Kumar Research Lab opportunity with Mass General Brigham at Mass General Brigham.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Research Associate 1 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Hologic, Inc. Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Research Associate 1 opportunity with Hologic, Inc. at Hologic, Inc..

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.body:
Dear Deloitte Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Analyst, Strategic Relationship Management - Deloitte University - Westlake opportunity with Deloitte at Deloitte.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Office Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Wythe County Community Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Office Coordinator opportunity with Wythe County Community Hospital at Wythe County Community Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in UNIT CLERK/SECRETARY/COORD — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear The George Washington University Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the UNIT CLERK/SECRETARY/COORD opportunity with The George Washington University Hospital at The George Washington University Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Behavior Technician (BT) / Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Hopebridge Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Behavior Technician (BT) / Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) opportunity with Hopebridge at Hopebridge.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Behavior Technician (BT) / Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) opportunity with Hopebridge at Hopebridge.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Program Manager, Recruiting Events
jobs.description: About the Team The Recruiting Events program powers OpenAI’s top-of-funnel hiring engine through strategic, high-impact experiences that connect exceptional talent with our people, mission, culture, and work. From intimate dinners that build deep connections to conferences that expand our reach, we curate experiences that spark curiosity, showcase our work, and bring “Why OpenAI?” to life. About the Role We’re hiring a Program Manager to own a portfolio of recruiting events that supports OpenAI’s hiring priorities. Working closely with the Manager of Recruiting Events Strategy and Recruiting leaders, you’ll shape and scale experiences that attract, engage, and nurture priority talent, helping candidates envision a career at OpenAI. You’ll translate hiring priorities into a thoughtful portfolio of event experiences and determine which events will most effectively engage the talent we need. You’ll help shape each experience’s goals, format, cross-functional participation, and success metrics, then lead initiatives from planning through delivery, follow-up coordination, and measurement. Your portfolio may evolve across business areas as hiring needs change. You’ll own end-to-end program delivery and outcomes across your recruiting events portfolio, partnering with the Events team on large-scale production and logistics. You should be comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to influence without owning every aspect of delivery. This role can be based in San Francisco or New York and requires being in the office three days per week. The role also requires extensive travel depending on the event schedule and workload, with occasional evening work as needed. In this role, you will: - Oversee programming across your recruiting events portfolio. Partner with Recruiting leads and hiring managers to prioritize monthly and quarterly event series based on hiring needs, target audiences, and partnerships. Apply the established program framework and lead initiatives end to end, adjusting plans as priorities evolve. - Shape program content and event experiences. Work with recruiters to inform event strategy, audience and invitation plans, and speaker participation. Oversee the development of panels, product showcases, and other programming that reflects OpenAI’s recruiting brand and voice and supports each initiative’s objectives. - Lead cross-functional partnerships. Align priorities, responsibilities, and timelines with Events, Workplace, Design, Communications, Marketing, and Procurement, resolving dependencies and guiding decisions that keep programs moving. - Own program execution and post-event follow-up. Work closely with Recruiting Events coordinators to keep delivery on track across the portfolio. Ensure attendance and engagement information are captured, coordinate candidate follow-up with Recruiting partners, and establish clear ownership of next steps through program closeout. - Manage portfolio performance and recommend improvements. Own KPI tracking and post-event reporting, using candidate feedback, hiring trends, pipeline progression, conversion, and hiring outcomes to assess program effectiveness and inform future programming. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 6+ years of professional experience, with a background in recruiting programs or event program management. - Have a track record of independently owning a portfolio of recurring event programs, with clear examples of how you improved execution, scaled programming, and measured outcomes. - Make sound prioritization decisions and tradeoffs, anticipate risks, and adapt plans as hiring needs evolve. - Build trusted relationships with Recruiting leads and partners across Global Events, Workplace, and other functions. You communicate clearly, influence decisions, and align teams around shared priorities and responsibilities. - Bring creative judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to translate hiring needs into relevant audiences, compelling content, and thoughtful event experiences. - Are a proactive, resourceful problem-solver who can resolve delivery challenges while identifying improvements that help an established program scale. - Use data and qualitative feedback to evaluate performance, explain what is working, and make practical recommendations that strengthen recruiting outcomes. - Are comfortable using Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, Airtable, and Jira to manage programs, maintain visibility, and support collaboration. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. jobs.title: Produktspezialist:in (German-speaking)
jobs.description: You know SaaS. You like helping people get it right. And you'd rather have a real conversation than a hard sell. Do you speak German natively and want to help organisations get the most from a world-class SaaS platform? Then this might be the role you're looking for. Join a lean-by-design, globally recognised B2B SaaS company as the German-speaking specialist for our DACH+ markets. No cold calling, no quotas — just meaningful conversations that help interested people discover how our software makes their work easier, then supporting them brilliantly once they're on board. You won't be opening the market alone. Our marketing team already brings in German-speaking interest, and our experienced English-speaking sales colleagues handle these leads well. Your edge is simple and valuable: when a German-speaking prospect wants a demo auf Deutsch , or a new client wants onboarding and support in their own language, you're the person who makes that feel effortless — gründlich, verlässlich und auf den Punkt. Join our Rebel Alliance We're a diverse, remote crew that takes the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be a valued member of our global Client Success team, well supported with the tools, knowledge and people you need to do excellent work. In time you'll learn to work across teams and draw on our collective expertise — and you'll have real backing at every turn to grow into a confident product expert. What you'll do Run German-language demos for warm, interested leads — clearly and confidently Become a product expert (with our support) and answer client and prospect questions accurately Onboard and support clients in German and/or English, setting them up for success from day one Provide responsive, thoughtful support in either German or English Test scenarios carefully so your answers are technically correct, not guessed Report recurring issues to help us improve the product Build trust through honesty, empathy and reliability What you bring (essentials) Native-level German (C2) and strong business English Minimum 3 years SaaS experience in support, onboarding, implementation or technical pre-sales Real technical aptitude. Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, staging vs production, dev console and database queries are familiar — you needn't be a developer, but you should be genuinely comfortable around them and quick to learn the product's technical side A confident communicator, written and spoken, who listens well Comfortable discussing product value and guiding decisions — without the hard sell Highly organised and process-driven; at home in a remote, tool-rich setup Based in EMEA, ideally within DACH or close business-hours overlap (UTC+1/+2) Reliable internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace Nice to have Familiarity with awards, grants, recognition or programme-management workflows Experience supporting clients across both German and English The short version If you're technically sharp, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to be the German-speaking specialist our DACH+ clients rely on, we'd love to hear from you. Komm an Bord!
